description: Tendrils is building the new default chip for computation, a novel general-purpose architecture that scales to thousands of cores.
tagline: Tendrils - building the new default chip for computation
investment_thesis: Single-core CPU performance has been stagnant for two decades. The answer has been to bolt more cores onto an architecture that was never designed for parallelism, paying the price in cache coherency protocols, race conditions, and an entire industry of specialised accelerators papering over the cracks. Compute is hitting its ceiling exactly when AI is asking it to do more than ever before. Tendrils starts from a different foundation. By building hardware around interaction nets, a graph-based model of computation that is local, linear, and inherently parallel, they eliminate the bottlenecks that have constrained chip design for decades. Programs run in parallel out of the box. Memory management is automatic. Thousands of cores scale cleanly. It's a once-in-a-generation reset of general-purpose computing, and the substrate the next wave of AI and software will be built on. The barriers come down, and what we can compute becomes a question of imagination rather than silicon.
